passages.text: So they brought the ark of God and placed it inside the tent that David had pitched for it. And they presented burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel brought the ark of God.
They placed the ark inside the tent.
David had set up this tent for the ark.
The people offered burnt offerings before God.
They also offered peace offerings before God.
passages.original: וַיָּבִ֙יאוּ֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיַּצִּ֣יגוּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָאֹ֔הֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽטָה־ ל֖וֹ דָּוִ֑יד וַיַּקְרִ֛יבוּ עֹל֥וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: When David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David offered burnt offerings to God.
David also offered peace offerings to God.
David finished making these sacrifices.
David then blessed the people.
David blessed them in the name of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיְכַ֣ל דָּוִ֔יד מֵהַעֲל֥וֹת הָעֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then he distributed to every man and woman of Israel a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David gave gifts to the people of Israel.
He gave gifts to every man in Israel.
He gave gifts to every woman in Israel.
He gave each person a loaf of bread.
He gave each person a date cake.
He gave each person a raisin cake.
passages.original: וַיְחַלֵּק֙ לְכָל־ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאִ֖ישׁ וְעַד־ אִשָּׁ֑ה לְאִישׁ֙ כִּכַּר־ לֶ֔חֶם וְאֶשְׁפָּ֖ר וַאֲשִׁישָֽׁה׃

passages.text: David appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, to celebrate, to give thanks, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David chose some men from the tribe of Levi.
These men were Levites.
David gave them a special job.
He told them to serve in front of the ark of the LORD.
The ark of the LORD was a holy box.
The ark showed that God was with Israel.
The Levites had to remember the LORD.
They had to give thanks to the LORD.
They had to praise the LORD.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֞ן לִפְנֵ֨י אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה מִן־ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם מְשָׁרְתִ֑ים וּלְהַזְכִּיר֙ וּלְהוֹד֣וֹת וּלְהַלֵּ֔ל לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: Asaph was the chief, Zechariah was second, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel. They were to play the harps and lyres, while Asaph sounded the cymbals and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.
passages.sermon:
Asaph was the chief Levite musician.
Zechariah was second in command.
Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel served with them.
These men played harps and lyres.
Asaph played the cymbals and made a loud sound.
Benaiah and Jahaziel were priests.
Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets.
They blew the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.
passages.original: אָסָ֥ף הָרֹ֖אשׁ וּמִשְׁנֵ֣הוּ זְכַרְיָ֑ה יְעִיאֵ֡ל וּשְׁמִֽירָמ֡וֹת וִֽיחִיאֵ֡ל וּמַתִּתְיָ֡ה וֶאֱלִיאָ֡ב וּבְנָיָהוּ֩ וְעֹבֵ֨ד אֱדֹ֜ם וִֽיעִיאֵ֗ל בִּכְלֵ֤י נְבָלִים֙ וּבְכִנֹּר֔וֹת וְאָסָ֖ף בַּֽמְצִלְתַּ֥יִם מַשְׁמִֽיעַ׃ וּבְנָיָ֥הוּ וְיַחֲזִיאֵ֖ל הַכֹּהֲנִ֑ים בַּחֲצֹצְר֣וֹת תָּמִ֔יד לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: On that day David first committed to Asaph and his brothers this song of thanksgiving to the LORD: “Give thanks to the LORD; call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
On that day, David gave a song of thanks to the LORD.
David gave this song to Asaph and his brothers.
Asaph and his brothers were Levites.
David told them to thank the LORD.
He told them to call on the LORD’s name.
He told them to tell all nations about what the LORD has done.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא אָ֣ז נָתַ֤ן דָּוִיד֙ בָּרֹ֔אשׁ לְהֹד֖וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה בְּיַד־ אָסָ֖ף וְאֶחָֽיו׃פ הוֹד֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֔וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָעַמִּ֖ים עֲלִילֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
Sing to God.
Praise God with music.
Speak about all the wonderful things God has done.
passages.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ לוֹ֙ זַמְּרוּ־ ל֔וֹ שִׂ֖יחוּ בְּכָל־ נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
passages.sermon:
God is holy.
His name is holy.
Honor His holy name.
Rejoice if you seek the LORD.
Let your heart be glad if you look for Him.
passages.original: הִֽתְהַֽלְלוּ֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֔וֹ יִשְׂמַ֕ח לֵ֖ב מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He is strong.
Seek the LORD.
Seek His strength.
Always look for His presence.
passages.original: דִּרְשׁ֤וּ יְהוָה֙ וְעֻזּ֔וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֥וּ פָנָ֖יו תָּמִֽיד׃

passages.text: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced, O offspring of His servant Israel, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
passages.sermon:
God chose Israel as His people.
God chose the sons of Jacob as His special ones.
God did many wonders.
God performed great marvels.
God spoke judgments with His mouth.
Remember all the wonders God has done.
Remember His marvels.
Remember the judgments He has pronounced.
passages.original: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאֹתָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה מֹפְתָ֖יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־ פִֽיהוּ׃ זֶ֚רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדּ֔וֹ בְּנֵ֥י יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃

passages.text: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
passages.sermon: The LORD is our God.\r\nHe rules over all the earth.\r\nHis judgments reach everywhere.
passages.original: ה֚וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ בְּכָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃

passages.text: Remember His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations— the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
passages.sermon:
God made a covenant.
God made this covenant with Abraham.
God swore an oath to Isaac.
God commanded this word for a thousand generations.
God’s covenant lasts forever.
Remember this covenant always.
passages.original: זִכְר֤וּ לְעוֹלָם֙ בְּרִית֔וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה לְאֶ֥לֶף דּֽוֹר׃ אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּרַת֙ אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֔ם וּשְׁבוּעָת֖וֹ לְיִצְחָֽק׃

passages.text: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant: ‘I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.’
passages.sermon:
God made a promise to Jacob.
God set this promise as a law for Jacob.
God gave this promise to Israel as an everlasting covenant.
God said, “I will give you the land of Canaan.”
God said, “This land will be your inheritance.”
passages.original: וַיַּעֲמִידֶ֤הָ לְיַעֲקֹב֙ לְחֹ֔ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃ לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶֽרֶץ־ כְּנָ֔עַן חֶ֖בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land, they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
passages.sermon:
God chose the people of Israel.
They were very few in number.
They were strangers in the land.
They did not have a home of their own.
They moved from one nation to another nation.
They traveled from one kingdom to another people.
passages.original: בִּֽהְיֽוֹתְכֶם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר כִּמְעַ֖ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃ וַיִּֽתְהַלְּכוּ֙ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־ גּ֔וֹי וּמִמַּמְלָכָ֖ה אֶל־ עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃

passages.text: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf: ‘Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!’
passages.sermon:
God protected His chosen people.
He did not allow anyone to oppress them.
God rebuked kings for their sake.
God said, “Do not touch My anointed ones.”
God said, “Do no harm to My prophets.”
passages.original: לֹא־ הִנִּ֤יחַ לְאִישׁ֙ לְעָשְׁקָ֔ם וַיּ֥וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מְלָכִֽים׃ אַֽל־ תִּגְּעוּ֙ בִּמְשִׁיחָ֔י וּבִנְבִיאַ֖י אַל־ תָּרֵֽעוּ׃פ

passages.text: Sing to the LORD, all the earth. Proclaim His salvation day after day.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God over all the earth.
All people everywhere must sing to the LORD.
Proclaim the LORD’s salvation every day.
Tell others about His saving power each day.
passages.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־ אֶל־ י֖וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonderful deeds among all peoples.
passages.sermon:
God is great.
God is glorious.
God does wonderful deeds.
Tell about God's glory to people in every nation.
Tell about God's wonderful deeds to all peoples.
passages.original: סַפְּר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִם֙ אֶת־ כְּבוֹד֔וֹ בְּכָל־ הָעַמִּ֖ים נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
passages.sermon: The LORD is great.\r\nThe LORD deserves much praise.\r\nThe LORD is to be feared above all gods.
passages.original: כִּי֩ גָד֨וֹל יְהוָ֤ה וּמְהֻלָּל֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְנוֹרָ֥א ה֖וּא עַל־ כָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD made the heavens.
The gods of the nations are idols.
Only the LORD is the true Creator.
passages.original: כִּ֠י כָּל־ אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָעַמִּים֙ אֱלִילִ֔ים וַיהוָ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃

passages.text: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and joy fill His dwelling.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is great.
He is above all gods.
He made the heavens.
Splendor stands before Him.
Majesty stands before Him.
Strength fills His dwelling.
Joy fills His dwelling.
passages.original: ה֤וֹד וְהָדָר֙ לְפָנָ֔יו עֹ֥ז וְחֶדְוָ֖ה בִּמְקֹמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the one true God.
He made the heavens.
All other gods of the nations are idols.
Families of every nation, give glory to the LORD.
Give strength to the LORD.
passages.original: הָב֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֔ים הָב֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃

passages.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and come before Him. Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth. The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy and glorious.
He deserves honor because of His name.
Give the LORD the glory that belongs to Him.
Bring an offering to the LORD.
Come before the LORD.
Worship the LORD in the beauty of His holiness.
All the earth must tremble before the LORD.
God made the world strong and secure.
The world stands firm.
Nothing can move it.
passages.original: הָב֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂא֤וּ מִנְחָה֙ וּבֹ֣אוּ לְפָנָ֔יו הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה בְּהַדְרַת־ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃ חִ֤ילוּ מִלְּפָנָיו֙ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אַף־ תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּבֵ֖ל בַּל־ תִּמּֽוֹט׃

passages.text: Let the heavens be glad, and the earth rejoice. Let them say among the nations, ‘The LORD reigns!’
passages.sermon:
The LORD is King over all.
The heavens are glad.
The earth rejoices.
People in every nation say, “The LORD reigns.”
passages.original: יִשְׂמְח֤וּ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ וְיֹאמְר֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה מָלָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it; let the fields exult, and all that is in them.
passages.sermon:
The sea is vast.
The sea contains many things.
Let the sea make a loud sound.
Let everything in the sea join in this sound.
The fields cover the land.
Let the fields be full of joy.
Let everything in the fields share this joy.
passages.original: יִרְעַ֤ם הַיָּם֙ וּמְלוֹא֔וֹ יַעֲלֹ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for He is coming to judge the earth.
passages.sermon: The LORD is coming to judge the earth.\r\nThe trees of the forest will sing for joy before Him.
passages.original: אָ֥ז יְרַנְּנ֖וּ עֲצֵ֣י הַיָּ֑עַר מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כִּי־ בָ֖א לִשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: The LORD is good.\r\nHis loving devotion lasts forever.\r\nGive thanks to the LORD.
passages.original: הוֹד֤וּ לַיהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then cry out: ‘Save us, O God of our salvation; gather and deliver us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.’
passages.sermon:
God is the God who saves us.
Cry out to Him.
Say, “Save us, O God of our salvation.”
Ask Him to gather us.
Ask Him to deliver us from the nations.
We want to give thanks to His holy name.
We want to glory in His praise.
passages.original: וְאִמְר֕וּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֙נוּ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֔נוּ וְקַבְּצֵ֥נוּ וְהַצִּילֵ֖נוּ מִן־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם לְהֹדוֹת֙ לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֔ךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּ֖חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.” Then all the people said, “Amen!” and “Praise the LORD!”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD deserves blessing.
The LORD exists from everlasting to everlasting.
All the people said, “Amen!”
All the people said, “Praise the LORD!”
passages.original: בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן־ הָעוֹלָ֖ם וְעַ֣ד הָעֹלָ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ כָל־ הָעָם֙ אָמֵ֔ן וְהַלֵּ֖ל לַֽיהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: So David left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to minister there regularly according to the daily requirements, along with Obed-edom and his sixty-eight relatives. Obed-edom son of Jeduthun, and also Hosah, were to be gatekeepers.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David left Asaph and Asaph’s brothers before the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
The ark of the covenant was a holy object.
Asaph and his brothers served before the ark every day.
They did what was required each day.
Obed-edom and his sixty-eight relatives were also there.
Obed-edom was the son of Jeduthun.
Obed-edom and Hosah were gatekeepers.
passages.original: וַיַּֽעֲזָב־ שָׁ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֔ה לְאָסָ֖ף וּלְאֶחָ֑יו לְשָׁרֵ֞ת לִפְנֵ֧י הָאָר֛וֹן תָּמִ֖יד לִדְבַר־ י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃ וְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם שִׁשִּׁ֣ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֑ה וְעֹבֵ֨ד אֱדֹ֧ם בֶּן־ יְדִית֛וּן וְחֹסָ֖ה לְשֹׁעֲרִֽים׃

passages.text: And David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place in Gibeon to regularly present burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offerings, morning and evening, according to all that was written in the Law of the LORD, which He had commanded Israel to keep.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests at the tabernacle of the LORD.
The tabernacle was at the high place in Gibeon.
Zadok and the other priests served before the tabernacle.
They presented burnt offerings to the LORD.
They offered sacrifices on the altar of burnt offerings.
They did this every morning and every evening.
They followed everything written in the Law of the LORD.
The LORD had commanded these things for Israel.
passages.original: וְאֵ֣ת׀ צָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאֶחָיו֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה בַּבָּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃ לְֽהַעֲלוֹת֩ עֹל֨וֹת לַיהוָ֜ה עַל־ מִזְבַּ֧ח הָעֹלָ֛ה תָּמִ֖יד לַבֹּ֣קֶר וְלָעָ֑רֶב וּלְכָל־ הַכָּתוּב֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: With them were Heman, Jeduthun, and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the LORD, for “His loving devotion endures forever.”
passages.sermon:
Heman was with them.
Jeduthun was with them.
Other people were with them.
These other people were chosen.
People chose them by name.
They gave thanks to the LORD.
The LORD’s loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: וְעִמָּהֶם֙ הֵימָ֣ן וִֽידוּת֔וּן וּשְׁאָר֙ הַבְּרוּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת לְהֹדוֹת֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Heman and Jeduthun had with them trumpets and cymbals for the music and instruments for the songs of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate.
passages.sermon:
Heman and Jeduthun were Levites who served in the worship of God.
They had trumpets and cymbals with them.
They used these instruments to make music.
They also had other instruments for the songs of God.
The sons of Jeduthun stood at the gate.
passages.original: וְעִמָּהֶם֩ הֵימָ֨ן וִֽידוּת֜וּן חֲצֹצְר֤וֹת וּמְצִלְתַּ֙יִם֙ לְמַשְׁמִיעִ֔ים וּכְלֵ֖י שִׁ֣יר הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וּבְנֵ֥י יְדוּת֖וּן לַשָּֽׁעַר׃

passages.text: Then all the people departed for their homes, and David returned home to bless his household.
passages.sermon:
All the people left.
Each person went to his own home.
David also went home.
David blessed his household.
passages.original: וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ כָל־ הָעָ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ לְבֵית֑וֹ וַיִּסֹּ֥ב דָּוִ֖יד לְבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת־ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃פ
